pairs.subject: module-design
pairs.evidence: src/lib/api.ts:145 One ApiClient interface has four adapters (realApi, supabaseApi, desktopApi, mockApi) and a single place that chooses between them, and the session verifier injects fetch, clock and config, so both substitution and isolated testing happen at defined seams.

techniques.evidence: src/lib/api.ts:145 The real and demo planes are adapters of one caller-owned interface. The demo-only standalone fetchers outside ApiClient are reached only through useDemoOnlySWR, so a live session never gets mock data.

src/lib/api.ts:445 An interception proxy that adds a capability (plane selection) and forwards a surface typed by the locally owned ApiClient; it does not create a distinction that delegation could dissolve.
src/app/api/orchestrator/userSession.ts:57 Token → verdict hides the digest-keyed TTL cache, size limit, auth timeout and the 4xx/429/5xx mapping behind one call.

src/app/api/orchestrator/[...path]/route.ts:33 The path-escape decision is a pure function of values, and so is relayHeaders. Both are private, though, and are exercised only through the handler with a stubbed global fetch.
src/lib/dashboard-queries.ts:16 The fan-out sits in the loader at the edge; the adapters and the decisions in them stay sequential.
src/lib/mockApi.ts:1 Mock behaviour and fixture data are split by reason to change, and mockModuleLayers.test.ts enforces the split, so the structural decision is a rule the build checks.
src/app/api/orchestrator/userSession.ts:48 A pure one-to-one transformation written as a pipeline.
src/app/api/orchestrator/proxy.test.ts:108 The host type (NextRequest) can be constructed in a test, so the mirror type's precondition does not hold.
src/app/api/orchestrator/userSession.ts:97 There is one cache per server instance and no forked lanes, so nothing copies state across a lane boundary.
